summary: Soften busy backgrounds behind the native Mac menu-bar panel while preserving its glass surface

schema.detail: Native client presentation only; no schema or codegen changes.

rules.detail: Attention and answer behavior are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: One appearance-aware root tint covers both panel columns, reducing backdrop contrast while retaining native glass. Reduce Transparency continues to use the system surface without the extra tint.

recovery.detail: Restore the previous native app package to roll back; daemon state is unchanged.
